tiers.name: fast
tiers.criteria: Lookup, search, listing, reading, extraction, summaries and classification. No edits, or purely mechanical ones such as renames, version bumps and replacing one value with another.

tiers.name: balanced
tiers.criteria: Specified edits, a local fix whose cause is known, work whose tests already exist.

tiers.name: strong
tiers.criteria: Unknown-cause debugging, design, cross-file judgment, review of risky code.

efforts.name: low
efforts.criteria: Quick, easy or exploratory work where a first pass is enough.

efforts.name: medium
efforts.criteria: Regular implementation, such as a new feature with clear requirements.

efforts.name: high
efforts.criteria: Verification matters or edge cases are likely, such as a bug fix in existing code.

efforts.name: xhigh
efforts.criteria: Many hidden edge cases, or security and data consequences.
